name: Tailwind CSS
summary: Utility-first CSS framework for building custom interfaces with small utility classes written in the markup.
description: A utility-first CSS framework: small classes like flex, pt-4 and text-center for layout, typography, color, filters, transitions, dark mode, container queries and 3D transforms, composed straight in the markup. Ships as npm packages with Vite and PostCSS integrations plus a standalone CLI, with full documentation and framework guides.
contains: utility classes for layout, flexbox and grid, spacing, sizing, typography, backgrounds, borders, effects and filters
responsive breakpoints, dark mode, CSS variables theming and P3 colors
container queries, gradients, transitions and 3D transforms
installs via npm as a Vite plugin, PostCSS plugin or standalone CLI
docs with installation guides, framework guides and a full utility reference
showcase of production sites: OpenAI/ChatGPT, Shopify, Cursor, The Verge, TED, NASA JPL
removes unused CSS on build; most projects ship under 10kB of CSS
